    Overwrite specific fields of a freshly-auto-built attributes tibble with saved values, matched by attributeName. Never replaces the tibble wholesale - see file header note for the full contract: new columns keep their fresh defaults, columns present in saved data but missing from the current file are simply not restored (reported separately via the returned $missing_columns), and existing matches get their editable fields overwritten in place.

    restore_attributes_by_name.Rd

    Overwrite specific fields of a freshly-auto-built attributes tibble with saved values, matched by attributeName. Never replaces the tibble wholesale - see file header note for the full contract: new columns keep their fresh defaults, columns present in saved data but missing from the current file are simply not restored (reported separately via the returned $missing_columns), and existing matches get their editable fields overwritten in place.

    restore_attributes_by_name(fresh_attrs, saved_attrs)

    Arguments

    fresh_attrs

    the just-built (build_attributes_tibble()) tibble for the CURRENT re-uploaded file

    saved_attrs

    list-of-columns shape (jsonlite simplifyVector) for this table's saved attributes, or NULL

    Value

    list(attrs = tibble, new_columns = character vector, missing_columns = character vector)
